dedupe_keys.name: modelling of rc walls and rc wall buildings

description: Modelling of RC Walls and RC Wall Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Alex Shegay, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). This project consists of two studies. The first is an OpenSees model calibration study, where a modelling approach is developed to model RC walls, particularly to capture deformation capacity. The second study is a building analysis study to determine the performance of an archetype RC wall building located in Wellington, New Zealand. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-jd35-bw27. Keywords: OpenSees, beam-column fiber elements, PBEE, regularization, concrete crushing energy, multiple-stripe analysis. Published 2019-06-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
